image_prompt:
A full-bleed portrait 9:16 frame of a richly cinematic dimensional storybook-animation mosque-courtyard wedding invitation. Soft romantic late-2000s South Indian cinema mood: dreamy natural light, intimate coastal Kerala atmosphere, gentle teal-and-warm contrast, quiet emotional longing. Soft cream and powder-blue palette with pearl highlights, pale pink florals and cool backwaters haze beyond coconut palms. Cream and gold plaster arches, laterite stone accents, one dome, one courtyard pool, and palms. Premium animated adult characters with sculpted expressive faces, never photographic people. DRAMATIC CHIAROSCURO: gentle warm back-and-side sunlight streams diagonally through arched openings and open porch bays, clearly visible soft volumetric god rays cutting through thin coastal atmospheric haze; luminous rim light on cream silk, lace, pearl and champagne-gold frames against cooler powder-blue shade. Preserve readable highlights, not a flat uniformly bright wash. Very fine dust motes sparkle only inside the sunbeams. Floor is subtly reflective worn cream stone or polished laterite tile, not a mirror. Gold lettering has illuminated beveled edges, warm restrained emissive bloom, luminous hairline flourishes and discrete pinpoint highlights; sharp readable counters. Fixed floral wedding décor of white jasmine, soft pink roses, baby's breath and green foliage — not marigold temple swags as primary. Roughly 12 to 20 tiny separate white, soft-pink and cream petals already scattered irregularly through the whole depth volume: a few soft near-lens edge petals, crisp midground petals, tiny distant petals. No confetti cannon, solid flower bunches in the air, symmetrical particle rows or dense shower from one point. All bouquets and garlands are fixed to their supports. Generate only from this text, no reference image. No watermark, interface, duplicate people, extra signs or unintended words.

Adult groom, visibly polished storybook 3D animation, warm medium-brown skin, slender adult oval face, large dark-brown almond eyes, thick dark eyebrows, smooth clean-shaven cheeks and chin, soft black hair with a gentle side part, quiet reserved smile. No moustache or beard. Natural adult proportions, not a child. Cream and champagne-gold sherwani over a pale inner layer, with a soft white-and-pale-pink boutonniere. Keep this face, hair, body and sherwani consistent in every couple scene.

Adult bride, visibly polished storybook 3D animation, warm medium-brown skin, graceful oval face, large dark-brown almond eyes, gently arched black eyebrows, soft smile. A neatly wrapped cream hijab with white jasmine accents and pearl earrings. Modest cream-and-gold bridal attire with long sleeves, covered shoulders and a flowing hem panel. Natural adult proportions and a consistent face, hijab, jewelry and attire in every later scene.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
The same animated bride and groom stand close together beneath a wide cream-and-gold arched compound gateway, bride LEFT of groom. Both retain the sherwani, hijab, modest cream-and-gold bridal attire, jasmine accents, pearl earrings and white-and-pale-pink garlands. Full bodies and shoes visible, couple occupies about 57 percent of image height and the middle-left 48 percent of width. They face mostly toward the camera with small soft smiles, standing close, faces apart, hands low and not the focus, feet planted. EXACTLY ONE illuminated hanging sign suspended from the gateway arch, slightly to the right of the couple, entire sign visible, about 24 percent of frame width, with no overlapping second panel, no easel and no mirrored copy. Its exact stable gold lettering is 'Insha Allah'. No other written text in the whole image. The sign is simple and rigid so it can stay fixed during animation. One hanging soft lamp is already attached near the sign. Warm lantern light and a pale sky beyond the arch, glowing rim light on the couple, deep cool plaster shadows, subtle floor reflections. A hint of palms and, far through the arch, only the one dome. Around 12 tiny separate petals suspended at irregular heights and depths. All bouquets, garlands, columns, lamps and the single hanging sign are fixed scenery. They stand. The camera does not walk them. This is one facet of the SAME cream-and-gold mosque-courtyard wedding compound: one dome, one courtyard pool, palms, arched arcades. Any person present holds a still pose. The camera does not walk them.
